notes: Repeated R&D runs in one turn that could only re-see the same top card, then went broke on HQ runs without trashing anything; later sat on 12-23 credits clicking for credits for many turns while the Corp's naked remotes built 130 credits and scored out.
Solid tempo with Tollbooth/Resistor remotes and HHN pressure; minor waste from overdrawing with Sensie Actors Union and discarding, and tags were never punished.
Ran HQ three times with one card in it, then clicked for credits for about 12 straight turns up to 48 credits and never contested three agendas advanced in the same remote.
Scored steadily against a passive Runner, but looped Archived Memories into itself for nothing several times and never used the two Melange Mining Corps it installed.
Good HQ pressure with Paperclip and bad-publicity credits, smart Stimhack for a second steal, and trashed economy cards; a slightly slow start clicking for credits.

Built a remote with several ice but never installed an agenda, clicking for credits for 10+ turns to 33 credits while discarding; Fast Tracked GFI into HQ and left it there to be stolen, and a discarded Atlas was stolen from Archives.
Persistent R&D pressure through Data Raven won the game, but fired two Account Siphons into a known rezzed Enigma with no decoder and spent a lot of tempo on tags.
Ran a naked Adonis Campaign four times in one turn without trashing it despite having the credits, then clicked for credits for ten turns to 45 credits while the Corp scored four agendas uncontested.

Good early scoring behind Rototurret/Eli, but at 6 points spent six turns clicking for credits and discarding instead of drawing to find the last agenda, and never used Efficiency Committee clicks well.
Left R&D open for two turns while clicking for credits and lost SSL Endorsement through a single Mausolus, but otherwise iced remotes and scored efficiently with Blue Sun recursion.
Left R&D completely unprotected for nine turns against a Runner running it four times a turn, losing two agendas, though the Enigma remote scored reliably.
Slow setup that drew into discards, and with 18 credits drew cards instead of contesting a two-advanced card in a remote when the Corp was one agenda from winning.
Played Psychographics twice with no tags for nothing, then spent a click and 2 credits trashing DreamNet over and over for many turns, sitting at 0 credits for about ten turns before finally scoring.

Ran an unprotected R&D three or four times every turn, re-seeing the same top card, while the Corp advanced and scored two Atlases and a GFI in a remote with one unrezzed ice that the Runner had already passed freely.
Won through R&D/HQ pressure, but kept reinstalling Astrolabe, Corroder and Daily Casts right before running into Archangel, which bounced them every time, and once ran a known Cobra with no killer.
Used Consulting Visit into Audacity to trash its entire hand with nothing to advance, then installed agendas behind one ice into a rich Runner three times and lost all of them, ending at 0 credits.
Won through persistent R&D and Archives pressure with a good Data Leak Reversal and tags combo, but facechecked Cobra on turn 1 with a tiny grip and nearly decked itself with MaxX.

Built a heavily iced remote but never installed an agenda there, clicking for credits for roughly 25 turns to 46 credits while Obokata and Send a Message sat in HQ to be stolen, and finally decked out.
Clean Biotic Labor fast advance of AstroScript, used counters well, and scored behind layered ice; only a few idle credit clicks.
After losing Aumakua to Archer, clicked for credits for seven turns up to 34 credits and never contested a GFI left at two advancements overnight or an HQ with one ice.
